mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5% over three months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 5.0 and remains there for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods where UNRATE > 5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces earnings expectations and depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods where GDPC1 falls for 3 quarters (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods of sustained FEDFUNDS increases (t-test p > 0.05).
